selected_idea.acceptance_test: Two concurrent runs produce one payment. A changed payee or excess amount is rejected. Pausing prevents new transfers. Show an actual KeeperHub execution and explorer receipt.
selected_idea.brief: A payment desk for small teams using Safe. Approve an invoice once, then let KeeperHub pay it within a fixed allowance and save the receipt.
selected_idea.difference: Safe already supports spending limits. The proposed value is the invoice lifecycle, duplicate prevention and clear recovery when a transaction is pending.
selected_idea.name: Payroom
selected_idea.problem: Payment requests, multisig approvals and final receipts often live in different places.
selected_idea.risk: More contract work than the other options. Owner approval is required to enable a module. The built-in KeeperHub Safe plugin is read-only, so use verified direct contract calls.
selected_idea.scope: Sepolia-only demo with test tokens, one Safe, explicit recipient and token allowlists, per-invoice nonce, daily cap, pause control and receipt reconciliation.
selected_idea.sponsor_use: KeeperHub schedules checks and executes a constrained payment through a Safe module or compatible adapter. Safe remains the named existing protocol.
selected_idea.user: Small protocol teams paying recurring contributors.
